summaries.title: 3D-LLM: Injecting the 3D World into Large Language Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **3D-LLM** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model (VLM)）。核心论点主张：In this work, we propose to inject the 3D world into large language models and introduce a whole new family of 3D-LLMs。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this work, we propose to inject the 3D world into large language models and introduce a whole new family of 3D-LLMs。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **9%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments on ScanQA show that our model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by a large margin (e.g., the...；Qualitative examples also show that our model could perform more tasks beyond the scope of existing LLMs and VLMs）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 40 赞），本工作为突破 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: A Real-World WebAgent with Planning, Long Context Understanding, and Program Synthesis
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限、系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **A Real-World WebAgent with Planning,** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：We introduce WebAgent, an LLM-driven agent that can complete the tasks on real websites following natural language instructions。

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **50%, 14.9%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We empirically demonstrate that our recipe improves the success on a real website by over 50%, and that HTML-T5 is the best model to solve HTML-based tasks; achieving 14.9% higher...）。
